purpose: Native-only capability licensing for a fresh matched-natural Task14 authority before any new L11H3 QK intervention is designed or run.
scientific_scope: Capability only. This receipt registers no QK, attention-head, source-term, interchange, removal, or causal outcome.

prior_art_audit.finding: Claim v10 leaves fresh-text natural-QK confirmation missing and forbids weakening the failed liveness bar.
The OOD-text result used a new intervention on previously opened text and therefore is not pristine fresh confirmation.

The first fresh result is instrument-invalid. Native roles and exact algebra passed, but opposite versus recipient score mixed subject number with a foreign prefix and failed one frozen row-sign cell. Its outcomes are not used to select rows, nouns, or templates here.
The prior authority supplied recipient and foreign same/opposite donors. It did not provide a token-8-only recipient/opposite pair plus a matched same-number lexical control.
The generic fail-closed license binds an authority file, logical digest, exact registered cells, and a reproducible passing native-only result.

endpoint_roles.recipient: The grammatical subject has the recipient number and lemma.
endpoint_roles.opposite_same_lemma: The exact same prefix and subject lemma are retained; only subject token 8 changes to the opposite-number form.
endpoint_roles.same_number_different_lemma: The exact same prefix and grammatical number are retained; only subject token 8 changes to a different lemma from the same phase.

balance_and_freshness.cells: For each phase, template, recipient-number direction, and endpoint role there are exactly four endpoints, covering all four two-attractor plurality states once.
balance_and_freshness.token_alignment: All prompts contain exactly nine GPT-2 tokens, the grammatical subject is token index 8, and paired roles differ from the recipient only at index 8.
balance_and_freshness.prior_disjointness: All 32 noun forms and all 96 complete prompt/token endpoints are disjoint from the original Task14 authority and the first fresh natural-QK authority.
balance_and_freshness.phase_disjointness: FIT and HOLDOUT use disjoint eight-pair noun vocabularies. The two frozen syntactic templates and is/are answer tokens are intentionally shared.

native_capability_rule.attainable_requirement: Because each cell has four examples, every cell must be 4/4 correct.
native_capability_rule.fit_gate: Evaluate only all 48 FIT endpoints. Every one of the 12 FIT cells must pass before HOLDOUT can be opened.
native_capability_rule.holdout_gate: If FIT passes, evaluate all 48 HOLDOUT endpoints. Every one of the 12 HOLDOUT cells must pass before issuing a license.
native_capability_rule.failure: Any failed FIT cell stops before HOLDOUT. Any failed HOLDOUT cell emits no license. No row removal, role removal, template fallback, or threshold change is permitted.

license_design.binding: A future causal runner must validate the exact authority file SHA, logical SHA, registered-cells SHA, capability-result SHA, license SHA, and causal candidate ID before enqueue or model loading.

interpretation_limits: Passing establishes only that every frozen natural endpoint is natively answerable; it is not causal evidence.
The HOLDOUT half is lexically and prompt-disjoint, not template-disjoint.
The later score comparison may isolate a matched natural subject-number change, but it will still combine the natural query and key changes caused by token 8.
Task margin and full-vocabulary CE are capability diagnostics here, not evidence of simplicity or circuit extraction.
